name: Code Graph
description: AST-based code entity search. Extracts modules, classes, functions, APIs, and cross-service interactions across 10+ languages; exposes search_code_graph and query_code_structure tools.

install._note: Code graph lives inside the same orchestrator repo as vct-kg. Installing vct-kg already brings the code graph scripts; this module just registers them as a separate named MCP capability for the Store/Dashboard UI.

settings.description: gpu = use the local CodeSage GPU service; ollama = fall back to Ollama jina-v2-base-code (CPU-friendly but lower quality)

runtime._note: Code graph is invoked on demand (analyze_code_graph.py / query_code_graph.py) rather than as a long-running process. The MCP entry points live in vct-kg's weaviate_mcp/server.py.

mcp_registration._note: Disabled by default; tools are already exposed via weaviate-kg MCP. Turn on only for a separate CLI workflow.

uninstall._note: Shared install_dir with vct-kg — do not remove the dir on uninstall.
